Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & procurement questions from today's call

Hi Emily -

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation with the product and procurement teams. Quick recap and a few asks so we can keep the vendor intake moving:

1) Commercial path: you mentioned NewCo prefers PO-based purchasing for platform vendors. Can you confirm whether this will be a standard PO to Redwood (Net terms) or done through a marketplace (AWS/GCP) purchase?

2) Vendor setup docs: what specific packet does NewCo need for vendor onboarding? Most customers ask for a W-9 (US), vendor packet, and banking details for ACH. If you need a W-8 instead, let me know.

3) Timing & owner: who should we send the vendor packet to in procurement? If there's a vendor portal enrollment link, feel free to send it and we'll complete onboarding right away.

Next steps on our side: I can attach our standard vendor packet and W-9, and loop in our finance ops lead (Dev) to provide bank details securely. I can also generate a DocuSign packet if that's preferred.

Attached: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (vendor packet stub), W-9_Redwood.pdf

Thanks - happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the recap and the attachments - helpful. A few notes from procurement:

- We do prefer PO-based purchases with Net30 as the standard term.
- For a direct PO to Redwood we'll need your vendor packet + a current W-9 and bank details for ACH.
- We also evaluate marketplace purchases for certain buys; for this engagement we'll likely take the direct PO route (simpler for this approval).

Please send the bank wiring/ACH details and the person we can reach for invoicing questions. Also, can you confirm Redwood's legal entity name and remit-to address as it should appear on the PO?

CC'ing our systems contact Carlos in case we need to set up a vendor portal account or send an invite link.

Emily
